primitives.name: Coach-First Seal Invariant
primitives.verbatim_quote: Core Invariant Restated All projections, rankings, fourth-down policies, and positional value tables originate from a bottom-up Belichick-Adams Coach-First simulation locked every Tuesday at 04:00 CT (v1.0).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'τττ': 'inverse-MDP fourth-down risk preference (dimensionless)', 'CCC': 'scheme interchangeability cost matrix (unitless)', 'EPA_dropoff': 'expected points added dropoff table (points)'}
primitives.assumptions: All tactical decisions are derived from a fixed simulation prior to seal; external inputs do not alter internal state.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Post-seal modification of any component invalidates the invariant.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a deterministic causal model where the seal acts as a global synchronization point for all agent policies.
layer2.telemetry: SHA-256 digest (coachMindsetHash) confirms integrity of sealed parameters.

primitives.name: Entropy-Regularized Sinkhorn-Knopp Optimal Transport
primitives.verbatim_quote: Mid-week injury versions (v2.0–v4.0) may only reallocate execution weights via entropy-regularized Sinkhorn-Knopp optimal transport and multiply by pre-sealed EPA dropoff factors.
primitives.assumptions: Injury reallocations must preserve marginal distributions while minimizing transport cost.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when marginal constraints are violated or regularization is insufficient.

layer2.mapping: Used to dynamically adjust player weights under injury scenarios while maintaining sealed EPA consistency.
layer2.telemetry: Weight redistribution entropy matches expected variance in mid-week injury models.

primitives.name: Sealed EPA Dropoff Table Freeze
primitives.verbatim_quote: At seal, the engine serializes team ratings, scheme interchangeability cost matrix CCC, inverse-MDP fourth-down risk preference τ\tauτ, and the Sealed EPA Dropoff Table into a 64-character SHA-256 digest (coachMindsetHash).
primitives.assumptions: EPA dropoffs are static post-seal and used exclusively for policy evaluation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Any deviation from frozen table results in hash mismatch.

layer2.mapping: Represents a fixed functional map from game state to tactical value, akin to a reward function in reinforcement learning.
layer2.telemetry: SHA-256 hash of EPA table ensures immutability across simulations.
